referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Offshore substation of a 150 MW offshore wind farm. Included processes: manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data are based on the Ormonde offshore wind farm, UK, consisting of 30 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 5 MW.
Main data source for material composition: Kouloumpis, V., & Azapagic, A. (2022). A model for estimating life cycle environmental impacts of offshore wind electricity considering specific characteristics of wind farms. Sustainable Production and Consumption, 29, 495–506. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spc.2021.10.024
referenceFunction.name: Substation,offshore, 150MW offshore wind farm
